entries.owner: McpCli maintainer.
entries.gate: Recorded obligation: When the Gateway URL and token come from flags or the environment, the selected profile still supplies the session tenant, actor, `allowTenantOverride` and `allowedExtensions`, so one environment's identity settings can accompany another environment's Gateway. Owner: McpCli maintainer. Recorded disposition: open; retain the source-spec acceptance gate Recorded gate evidence: Medium, pre-existing; found by the Story 5.3 review (EC4). `src/Hexalith.McpCli.Core/Settings/SettingsResolver.cs:92-93` resolves tenant and actor (and `:107` `allowTenantOverride`) from the flag, then the variable, then the selected profile regardless of the URL source, and `:119` and `:132` take `allowedExtensions` only from the selected profile. With an active profile for environment A and `--url`/`--token` (or `EVENTSTORE_URL`/`EVENTSTORE_TOKEN`) for environment B, profile A's tenant, actor, override permission and extension allowlist reach B's Gateway. The Gateway still authorizes the token and tenant independently, and Story 5.3's frozen matrix keeps one-source resolution "as today", so the change needs its own decision: ignore or refuse profile identity fields when the connection does not come from that profile, with full-document tests through both heads.

entries.owner: FrontComposer maintainer, with the McpCli maintainer for the label text.
entries.gate: Recorded obligation: Add the PS03/PS04 package-Description compatibility labels for `Hexalith.FrontComposer.Cli` and `Hexalith.FrontComposer.Mcp` through FrontComposer's dependency-policy reseal procedure. Owner: FrontComposer maintainer, with the McpCli maintainer for the label text. Recorded disposition: open; deferred by user decision (2026-11-10). The FrontComposer label commit is README-only, so it still meets Story 5.5 AC3, and the README label is unchanged. Recorded gate evidence: FrontComposer `eng/dependency_graph.py:353-363` folds every tracked `.csproj`, `.props`, `.targets`, `.proj`, `.slnx`, `.user` and `.rsp` file into `consumer_configuration_sha256` (`eng/dependency-graph-policy.json`). A Description change fails `dependency_graph.py diff --event push` with "consumer Compile/ProjectReference configuration changed from its sealed source projection", and the README says a reseal cannot authorize itself. Follow `eng/dependency-governance.md`: a reseal or activation push first, then the Description change. The prefix text is `labelTemplate.descriptionPrefix` in `evidence/story-5-5/labels.json`. The follow-up must also extend both Story 5.5 scripts.
